name: Vaporwave Arcade Dusk
description: Retro-futurist vaporwave digital aesthetic: neon wireframe grid horizon, chrome silhouettes, VHS scanlines over a dusk gradient.
magic_media_keywords: Vaporwave retro-futurist digital collage, neon wireframe grid horizon receding into a dusk gradient, chrome statue and palm silhouettes, VHS scanline shimmer, cool blue-hour ambient glow, glossy airbrushed sheen, one wide empty gradient sky held as negative space for typography.
palette_hint: arcade dusk — hot pink (#FF3CAC), sunset orange (#FF9052) and deep indigo (#2B1B67), anchored by near-black night (#10091E) against the pale glow (#F3EAFE) for legible contrast
best_for: synthwave playlists, retro-gaming tournaments, and ironic 80s/90s nostalgia campaigns with chrome and palm-tree sunsets
